_meta.purpose: Post-run editorial changes to the WP-C report; separate from run provenance (unmodified).

entries.reason: (1) N2 has four construction labels: overall chance is 0.250; scores near 0.499 reflect unresolved pairs of classes, not overall chance. (2) One paired draw at +/-1e-6 did not reproduce the WP-A difference; the unpaired WP-A comparison cannot isolate a sign effect, and the paired draw does not prove the earlier difference was caused entirely by draw variation.
entries.action: Edited make_report.py wording; re-ran make_report.py only. No synthetic experiment rerun.
entries.note: The run provenance records the pre-edit make_report.py hash; this entry explains the difference.
